ui_no_registration_advertising_or_a_00a2: No registration, advertising or analytics transmission. Recipes and kitchen data stay on this device. English photo recognition runs on device. Website import contacts the requested site and redirects. Voice is push-to-talk; your speech provider may process audio online. DishNest stores no raw audio. When configured, billing sends Amazon user and receipt identifiers to the verification service and Amazon; signed receipts are stored privately for restore and offline access. Cloud backup is not connected.
ui_no_store_prices_free_trials_or_p_dbbb: Subscriptions renew through Amazon until cancelled in your Amazon subscription settings. Amazon shows the applicable price, billing period and any offer before you confirm. A lifetime purchase is a single payment. No trial is promised by DishNest.
ui_off_by_default_counts_contain_no_6ec5: Off by default. Counts contain no recipe content, audio, names or identifiers. Nothing is transmitted. Switching off deletes these counters. Purchase and trial conversion counts are inactive while billing is disabled.
ui_permanently_remove_all_local_rec_62eb: Permanently remove all local recipes, plans, pantry items, shopping items, templates, timers and attached photos. Export anything you want to keep first.

ui_read_a_recipe_photo_on_your_devi_ea83: Read a recipe photo on your device. The bundled English OCR model works offline; accuracy depends on the photo. Your image is not uploaded.

ui_the_app_follows_your_device_s_la_2ed1: The app follows your device language, text size and layout direction. Interface translations are drafts awaiting native-speaker review. Cooking mode uses large text and keeps the screen awake.
ui_the_backup_will_be_validated_and_1a7d: The backup will be validated and added to an empty kitchen. Existing data will not be overwritten.
